post.title: Why a dozen Valentine's roses cost about $93
post.ig:
Why did a dozen Valentine's roses cost about $93?
The national average for a dozen long-stem red roses was $93.07 for Valentine's Day 2026, up from $80.16 in 2023 (FinanceBuzz).
A common florist rule of thumb: fresh flowers at 3.5x wholesale, hard goods 2.5x, plus 25% labor (Florists' Review).
Example: 12 stems at $1 = $12, x 3.5 = $42. At $2 a stem, the same math gives $84.
Colombia's growers expected about 20% of 2026 flower exports ($480M of $2.4B) from Valentine's season (Asocolflores).
Sources: FinanceBuzz, CBS News, Florists' Review, Asocolflores via El Colombiano.
News and education, not financial advice.
